text: Fix Network (Mondofix Inc., Blainville, Quebec) is led by President & CEO Steve Leal, who joined as a franchisee, led a 2013 buyout to become the largest shareholder of Fix Auto Canada, and took majority control of Fix Auto Canada Inc. and Mondofix Inc. in 2015 — a transaction in which Quebec's public pension-fund manager, the Caisse de Dépôt et Placement du Québec (CDPQ), came in as a minority stakeholder.
